resources.string: Help: %1$s
Choose country
Choose which VPN protocols the router will support. Hysteria2 is selected by default. Other protocols can be added after pairing with the router.
Choose a VPN profile from the phone to synchronize with the router. You can add it later.
When enabled, traffic for the selected country bypasses VPN on the router. Tap the flag to select or change the country.

The app automatically disconnects the phone’s current VPN connection when you join your trusted Wi-Fi network and pair with the router. When you leave that network, the app restores the phone’s previous connection using the last selected VPN profile.
Add your devices to the home-network device list so their traffic can use the router’s VPN connection.

If your router supports a static public IP address, it can act as a VPN gateway for your devices. Route: device → router; local traffic goes directly, while foreign traffic uses the active VPN connection.
Create a VPN profile on your router for your devices.
Enter the OpenWrt administrator password. The username is usually root.

Set a six-digit PIN at the end of initial setup. Use it to pair with the configured router. Later, the PIN can only be changed in LuCI using the owner account. There is no preset PIN.\n\nPairing: up to 10 mobile devices per router; up to 10 routers in one app.
With internal storage, VPN protocols survive a restart. With RAM storage, they are downloaded again after a restart to save space. Settings are saved in internal storage.

Install adds the FoxHole package to a supported OpenWrt router. Connect pairs the phone with an already installed FoxHole package. OpenWrt firmware is neither installed nor updated.\n\nPairing: up to 10 mobile devices per router; up to 10 routers in one app.
Enable phone management of a paired router. Disabling management does not delete the router’s VPN profiles.
Start or stop the selected VPN profile on the router.
Choose whether each home device routes its traffic through VPN or without VPN.
Available only with a static IP address. These profiles connect to the router away from home. You can share them or revoke access.
Delete only FoxHole settings, its PIN and client records. FoxHole will need to be configured again. OpenWrt and other application settings are preserved.
When enabled, local traffic bypasses VPN. For example, if the router is in RU, RU sites and services use the router’s IP address. Traffic to foreign services uses the active VPN connection.
Device status is reported by the router. If no data is available, the status is unknown.

Enable this if your devices will connect to this router over VPN using its direct IP address. A separate server package will be installed and needs additional memory. Access can be configured after installation.
